# Habits

> Habits is a local-first habit tracker for daily and weekly habits, with reminders, workspaces, and MCP access so AI agents can read and mark habits for you.

Habits stores your daily and weekly habits on your device first, then syncs them to your other devices. Reminders nudge you at a time you pick, and workspaces keep work, home, and health habits apart. Over MCP, your AI agent can see what's left today, mark or unmark a habit, and tell you your streak. Free: 25 agent tool calls per user per UTC day; sign-in, sync, and listing tools (`GET /api/tools`) don't count. Agent Access: $20 one time for unlimited agent calls for life, not a subscription.
